 Elina Svitolina beat Aryna Sabalenka 6-3, 3-6, 6-1 to reach the WTA Finals semifinals. It's her first victory over Sabalenka in six years. Svitolina, who won the Finals in 2018, will face Linda Noskova in the semifinals on Saturday. Mirra Andreeva beat Diana Shnaider 6-2, 6-1 and will play Jessica Pegula in the other semifinal. Shnaider replaced Karolina Muchova, who withdrew due to illness. Sabalenka had won six of their eight previous matches, but she came undone with 35 errors.

 INDIAN WELLS, Calif. (AP) — Elina Svitolina overcame Aryna Sabalenka 6-3, 3-6, 6-1 to reach the semifinals of the WTA Finals on Friday, winning on her fourth match point.
 Both players had more errors than winners. Svitolina hit 21 winners, made 24 errors and won six of eight break points in beating Sabalenka for the first time in six years and just the second in their eight career meetings.
